name: @litlfred/ihris
description: The iHRIS knowledge base: a folio-assistant-core dependent folio. These are the npm packages ihris's own code and the mounted platform layers it imports need (src/tools/validate-folio.ts loads folio-assistant-core's and cat-harness's zod schemas; src/tools/wireframe_check.mjs drives Playwright). The layers themselves come from index.lock.json via src/tools/mount_platform.sh.
